decisions.reason: As the firm's flagship GIS platform and strategic direction, it creates follow-on options across projects and services, so its option value remains high relative to the cost of keeping it on the market.

After several years, mobile field data capture is likely to have revealed enough about its prospects, and if traction has not clearly justified continued standalone maintenance, resources are better redeployed to the core platform and new developments.

The search extension showed post-launch versioning and fits the firm's reusable web-mapping stack, so it is relatively cheap to keep as a complementary option while still supporting customer solutions.
